package tzplanner

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

func TestEnsureAuthoringJobUsesExactV2ContractDedicatedTokenAndStrictReadyReceipt(t *testing.T) {
	flowID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	request := tzRequestFixture(flowID)
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, incoming *http.Request) {
		if incoming.Method != http.MethodPost || incoming.URL.Path != "/internal/v1/authoring-jobs" ||
			incoming.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "tz-only" || incoming.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key") != flowID ||
			incoming.Header.Get("Accept") != "application/json" || incoming.Header.Get("Content-Type") != "application/json" {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected request: %s %s headers=%v", incoming.Method, incoming.URL.Path, incoming.Header)
		}
		var got domain.TZAuthoringRequestV2
		decoder := json.NewDecoder(incoming.Body)
		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
		if err := decoder.Decode(&got); err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(got, request) {
			t.Fatalf("request=%+v err=%v", got, err)
		}
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(readyProjection(flowID, "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	job, err := (Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "tz-only", HTTPClient: server.Client()}).EnsureAuthoringJob(context.Background(), flowID, request)
	if err != nil || job.Status != domain.TZAuthoringReady || job.Intent.CorrelationID != flowID || job.BlueprintDigest == "" {
		t.Fatalf("job=%+v err=%v", job, err)
	}
}

func TestTZClientRejectsRedirectUnknownMediaOversizeAndMalformedReceipt(t *testing.T) {
	flowID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	request := tzRequestFixture(flowID)
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name    string
		handler http.HandlerFunc
	}{
		{name: "redirect", handler: func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
			writer.Header().Set("Location", "http://example.invalid/leak")
			writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusTemporaryRedirect)
		}},
		{name: "wrong media", handler: func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
			writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/plain")
			_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(readyProjection(flowID, "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"))
		}},
		{name: "unknown field", handler: func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
			writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{"id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","status":"PLANNED","attempts":0,"orchestration":{"schema":"learning-workspace-authoring-intent.v1","trigger":"planner_recommendation","correlation_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","surface_classification":"project"},"unexpected":true}`))
		}},
		{name: "oversize", handler: func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
			writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(strings.Repeat("x", int(maximumAuthoringResponseBytes+1))))
		}},
		{name: "bad verification digest", handler: func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
			projection := readyProjection(flowID, "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222")
			projection.Verification.ReceiptDigest = projectClientDigest("f")
			writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(projection)
		}},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			server := httptest.NewServer(testCase.handler)
			defer server.Close()
			_, err := (Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "tz-only", HTTPClient: server.Client()}).EnsureAuthoringJob(context.Background(), flowID, request)
			if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("unsafe response was accepted")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestTZClientClassifies404And5xxForRecovery(t *testing.T) {
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		status int
		want   error
	}{{http.StatusNotFound, domain.ErrNotFound}, {http.StatusServiceUnavailable, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable}} {
		server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) { writer.WriteHeader(testCase.status) }))
		_, err := (Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "tz-only", HTTPClient: server.Client()}).GetAuthoringJob(context.Background(), "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222")
		server.Close()
		if !errors.Is(err, testCase.want) {
			t.Fatalf("status=%d err=%v", testCase.status, err)
		}
	}
}

func tzRequestFixture(flowID string) domain.TZAuthoringRequestV2 {
	return domain.TZAuthoringRequestV2{
		Schema: domain.TZPlanningRequestSchemaV2, Mode: "private", Manifest: `{"schema":"planner-project-authoring-manifest.v1"}`, Locale: "ru",
		Source:        domain.TZAuthoringSource{Type: "user_intent", Anonymized: true},
		Hints:         domain.TZClassificationHints{Stacks: []string{"go"}},
		Orchestration: domain.TZAuthoringIntentV1{Schema: domain.TZAuthoringIntentSchemaV1, Trigger: "planner_recommendation", CorrelationID: flowID, SurfaceClassification: "project"},
	}
}

func readyProjection(flowID, jobID string) jobProjection {
	blueprint := json.RawMessage(`{"identity":{"family_key":"go-project"}}`)
	blueprintDigest := sha256.Sum256(blueprint)
	receipt := verificationReceiptProjection{
		Schema: domain.TZVerificationReceiptSchemaV1, BlueprintDigest: "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(blueprintDigest[:]),
		RuntimeProfileDigest: projectClientDigest("9"), ContractDigest: projectClientDigest("c"), CapabilitiesDigest: projectClientDigest("d"), Passed: true,
		Cases: []verificationCaseProjection{
			{ID: "starter", Kind: "starter", ExpectedPassed: false, ActualPassed: false, ResultDigest: projectClientDigest("1")},
			{ID: "reference", Kind: "reference", ExpectedPassed: true, ActualPassed: true, ResultDigest: projectClientDigest("2")},
			{ID: "negative-1", Kind: "negative", ExpectedPassed: false, ActualPassed: false, ResultDigest: projectClientDigest("3")},
		},
		VerifiedAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 5, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(receipt)
	receiptDigest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	receipt.ReceiptDigest = "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(receiptDigest[:])
	return jobProjection{
		ID: jobID, Status: domain.TZAuthoringReady, Attempts: 1,
		Orchestration: &domain.TZAuthoringIntentV1{Schema: domain.TZAuthoringIntentSchemaV1, Trigger: "planner_recommendation", CorrelationID: flowID, SurfaceClassification: "project"},
		Blueprint:     blueprint, CandidateDigest: projectClientDigest("b"), ContractDigest: receipt.ContractDigest,
		CapabilitiesDigest: receipt.CapabilitiesDigest, Verification: &receipt,
	}
}

func projectClientDigest(character string) string { return "sha256:" + strings.Repeat(character, 64) }

func TestStageUsesProviderReceiptAndRejectsMismatchedStaging(t *testing.T) {
	flowID, jobID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	for _, bad := range []string{"valid", "job", "digest", "identity", "state", "missing"} {
		t.Run(bad, func(t *testing.T) {
			projection := readyProjection(flowID, jobID)
			projection.Blueprint = json.RawMessage(`{"identity":{"family_key":"go-project","variant_key":"default"}}`)
			bh := sha256.Sum256(projection.Blueprint)
			projection.Verification.BlueprintDigest = "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(bh[:])
			projection.Verification.ReceiptDigest = ""
			encoded, _ := json.Marshal(projection.Verification)
			rh := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
			projection.Verification.ReceiptDigest = "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(rh[:])
			projection.Status = domain.TZAuthoringStaged
			projection.Staging = &domain.ProjectStagingReceiptV1{Schema: "practice-task-staging-receipt.v1", StagedID: flowID, AuthoringJobID: jobID, State: "staged", FamilyKey: "go-project", VariantKey: "default", CandidateDigest: projection.CandidateDigest, BlueprintDigest: projection.Verification.BlueprintDigest, CreatedAt: time.Now().UTC()}
			switch bad {
			case "job":
				projection.Staging.AuthoringJobID = flowID
			case "digest":
				projection.Staging.CandidateDigest = projectClientDigest("f")
			case "identity":
				projection.Staging.VariantKey = "different"
			case "state":
				projection.Staging.State = "published"
			case "missing":
				projection.Staging = nil
			}
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
				if r.Method != http.MethodPost || r.URL.Path != "/internal/v1/authoring-jobs/"+jobID+"/stage" || r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "tz-only" {
					t.Fatalf("wrong stage request: %s %s", r.Method, r.URL.Path)
				}
				w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
				_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(projection)
			}))
			defer server.Close()
			job, err := (Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "tz-only", HTTPClient: server.Client()}).StageAuthoringJob(context.Background(), jobID)
			if bad == "valid" {
				if err != nil || job.Status != domain.TZAuthoringStaged || job.Staging == nil || job.Publication != nil {
					t.Fatalf("stage=%+v err=%v", job, err)
				}
			} else if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("invalid stage accepted")
			}
		})
	}
}
